messages:
Harper J.: posted a compact mock for the alert rule card: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-handoff. Main ask: when space is tight can users still read thresholds, ordering, and quiet-hours at a glance? Eli K.: nice visuals. concern: overflow shows '+3' only. hides whether those are suppressed or just lower-priority. suggest '+3 (1 suppressed)' text on the overflow chip so the state is explicit. Rowan S.: agree. also tooltips are currently the only place with threshold numbers in compact view. tooltips are inaccessible. propose tiny inline chips like 'CRITICAL 90% (5m)' next to channel names. keeps density but surfaces key data. Priya S.: copy suggestion: replace 'Silence window' with 'Quiet hours (suppression window)' — clearer for non-ops users and keeps both terms for docs/search. Harper J.: good call on chips + copy. thinking timeline pill in preview: 48px bar with diagonal stripes for suppressed ranges, plus text fallback 'Suppressed 12am6am local'. also add a small timezone toggle (Local / UTC). a11y-bot: automated results: 1) microchips contrast 3.2:1 (fail) raise to >=4.5:1 for small text. 2) drag handles not keyboard focusable add tabindex=0 and visible 3px focus ring. 3) preview updates missing role on aria-live recommend
Preview...
. Eli K.: keyboard flow nit: tab order should be Threshold -> Agg window -> Preview (aria-live) -> Channel list -> Overflow -> Channel actions. preview needs to come before channels so screenreaders hear the live update right after edits. Rowan S.: add undo snackbar anchored to preview on inline edits: 'Threshold set to 85% Undo' with role=\"alert\" and keyboard-focusable undo button. helps reduce accidental-change anxiety. Priya S.: for SR markup I'm proposing this snippet: ```html
Preview: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; notifies PagerDuty then Slack.
Email suppressed between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM local time.
``` Harper J.: perfect. I'll update Figma with inline chips, overflow label showing suppressed count, striped timeline pill + timezone toggle, aria-live role=status, tabbable handles, and the undo toast. will post v2 for a quick a11y pass tomorrow. :thumbsup:
